description.value: The Railway Museum of British Columbia, operated by the non-profit West Coast Railway Association, preserves 95 heritage locomotives and railway cars in the spectacular mountain setting of Squamish on the Sea to Sky corridor. Visitors can climb into the cab of the Royal Hudson 2860 steam locomotive, ride the BC-21 Budd Rail Diesel Car, and explore restored luxury passenger cars inside the CN Roundhouse. It is a hands-on, immersive destination telling the story of the railways that shaped British Columbia and Western Canada.

raw_osm.name: Railway Museum of British Columbia
raw_osm.wheelchair:description: The parking lot is gravel, which makes t difficult to wheel through. All of the trains are not accessible as there are stairs to climb up to view inside. All of the hangars and roundhouse are at grade and can be wheeled into.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the museum is active for the 2026 season at 39645 Government Road, Squamish, with phone 604-898-9336 and email info@wcra.org closely matching OSM contact details. The website explicitly states 'Snacks, drinks and picnic area on site', confirming food/drink availability on the grounds. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or other cycle-specific amenities appears in the website content; OSM carries a toilets:wheelchair=yes tag but per rules this cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration.
concerns: Homepage states 'Open May 8 for the regular season' while the Plan Your Visit subpage states 'OPEN for the regular season Friday, April 17' — minor date inconsistency within the website.
OSM email is 'Info@wcra.org' (capital I); website shows 'info@wcra.org' — minor capitalization discrepancy, not a substantive conflict.
OSM tags toilets:wheelchair=yes and a detailed wheelchair:description suggest washrooms exist on site, but the website does not explicitly confirm; washroom status left null per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established heritage railway museum on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor in Squamish, clearly operating for the 2026 season; a legitimate destination attraction that touring cyclists would benefit from knowing about.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM old_name 'West Coast Railway Heritage Park' matches the About Us page note '(formerly the West Coast Railway Heritage Park)'. The OSM wheelchair:description notes the parking lot is gravel, which may present handling challenges for cyclists with loaded touring bikes.

Café or food on site.detail: Website states 'Snacks, drinks and picnic area on site.'

wow_evidence: 95 heritage locomotives incl. the Royal Hudson 2860, rides on the Budd car — major provincial railway collection, great half-day.
blurb: 95 heritage trains including the Royal Hudson, with rides.
